sources.label: 🧩 Android patches for Viber, BeReal, MovieBox, Proton Mail, Proton VPN, TeraBox
sources.author: hxreborn
patch_list: Adds 1,000 of each of ten boosters every time the game starts. Each booster unlocks at its usual level. Requires a standard install.
Adds five moves when each level starts. Requires a standard install.
Blocks game reminders and the prompt asking to allow notifications.
Stops AppsFlyer, Braze and Firebase Analytics data collection and blocks reads of the advertising ID and install referrer. Braze push and in-app messages stop too.
Stops rewarded and interstitial ads from loading.
Lists the game on the Android Auto car screen while parked. Requires Android 15 or newer and a standard install. Android Auto needs Unknown sources turned on in its developer settings.
Removes rating prompts and rate entry in Settings.
Adds 24 hours of unlimited lives every time the game starts. Requires a standard install.
Unlocks booster slots at any level. Requires a standard install.
